oracles.claim: Signature key generation shall consume its random seeds so that distinct randomness streams produce distinct keys.
limitations: Tests distinct-stream consumption only, not reported RNG failure
Low-entropy but successful RNG output is an RBG-health concern

controls.positive_control: the deterministic tape is observed to be consumed
controls.negative_control: the produced key pair signs and verifies

oracles.claim: Hedged signing shall consume its random seed so that distinct randomness streams produce distinct signatures.
limitations: Deterministic profiles legitimately ignore ambient randomness
Does not test reported RNG failure handling

controls.positive_control: the deterministic tape is observed to be consumed

oracles.claim: A signing input mutation that changes the message should change the produced signature bytes.
limitations: Hedged signing with fresh randomness also changes signatures, so the relation is only meaningful with controlled randomness

controls.negative_control: the mutation record shows the message changed

oracles.claim: A signing secret-key mutation that changes the used key material should change the produced signature.
oracles.source_reference: DeepSeek design doc Section 38.4 (relational key mutations)
limitations: Mutations in unused secret-key fields legitimately may not change the output

controls.negative_control: the mutation record shows the secret key changed

oracles.claim: A signature that verifies for one message shall not verify for a distinct message.
limitations: A single held-out message mutation is not a forgery search

controls.negative_control: the mutation record shows the message changed

oracles.claim: A mutated signature that verifies successfully is a critical signature-binding violation unless the mutation is a documented equivalent encoding.
limitations: Seed and mutation budgets bound the search; no forgery may be classified NO_COUNTEREXAMPLE, never a proof

controls.negative_control: the mutation record shows the signature changed

oracles.claim: A signature shall not verify under a different public key.
limitations: Cross-key candidates require a valid alternate key; the oracle records the replay requirements

controls.positive_control: the signature verifies under the original public key
controls.negative_control: the alternate public key is a valid key from a second key pair
